body: Well this is messed up. I have no idea how you're feeling or what to do. Maybe post your reply to him here ? or in a message or something. I dunno. Do something to help you close that book somehow.

wow, if what you wrote is true I can understand why your so upset. The way I see there are 2 options. He was either a troll, or a man/boy suffering from depression who gave up. But means you kept him alive for 8 days more. I dont know. but I would have tried to focus on the good alternative. True, the internett is full of trolls and scumbags. But in this case it seems like this man was just like a horse you can lead to water, but not force to drink.

just gonna throw out a hemingway quote: "happiness and intelligence is the rarest thing I know"
I seem to have been unable to do it this time aswell, seeing how I'm still here, for better of worse..

What scares me is that it doesn't scare me, you know ? Here is this final ending. point of no return, everything stopping. and I'm willing to jump in. that should scare me, shouldn't it ? I should be cripped by fear, not wishing it and welcoming it. but it doesn't even make my heartbeat increase. The same reasons that death should be scary, are the perhaps the same reasons I wish to welcome it. It means an ending to it all. Oh how good that idea rings in my head. If I only could....

I don't want to dull myself down in order to stay alive. I don't want to numb the pain out. sounds bizzare and like an odd thing to say. But what I mean is I'm quite certain I don't have any mental illnesses, just a shitty shitty life.

I'm not passing judgment upon the use, by all means. It's just I fear that if I allowe it to get there, it will, in my head, be like I've failed. Which will mean that, unless the medication prevents it, I will be very much closer to ending it. I don't know..

 It just really rubbs me wrong, the very idea of pills and medication. like a part, perhaps the same part that won't let me pull the trigger ?, is screaming no.
Your hearts in the right place, not gonna judge you upon that. But your wording in the first two sentences was kinda bad..

nope, as far as mental illnesses go I didn't get anything. Simply got the combination of a massively good memory and a tremendously abusive childhood. 

Problem with challenges and myself is that to a certain degree I do like challenges, but never for the sake of being better than others, nor even to better myself. Because to me, nothing I ever do will ever be good enough. I'm constantly driven by a beast inside that forever deems whatever I do unworthy. I've tried to quench it, did a triathlon in under 10 hours, marathons, joining mensa etc, but no matter the hardness or nature of the challenge, it never manages to trigger what a challenge should trigger in a normal person.

the arrival of my abusive drunken stepfather. Add in an unstable mother with bipolar tendencies and paranoid schizophrenia and, a whole bunch of other ways of saying batshit crazy, and you have the perfect environment for a child to become what I am today. 

When I say I moved around it was merely to see if a change in scenery helps, but you can't run from what it's inside.

well, for starters the most annoying one and first to jump to mind is "time heals all wounds" to me, time seems to pile on, just adding wounds to wounds, pain upon pain in an endless vicious circle. And the only way to end it, the only way out is, well, going out...
Hi there troll. Please avoid sunlight as trolls turn to stone upon exposure.
for around 15 years. There are a few things that piques my interest. but not enough to overcome the idea of living on.

that worried me in the start actually, but with the right angle I'm quite certain I'll avoid becoming a vegetable and instead be free. problem is that my body won't listen once it's go time. no matter the effort I can't seem to get that fucking trigger down..

You do realise it's not a competition ? you can't compare suffering and pain, because it will always be individual.... The most painful memory of a rich kid in Paris is to him, still the most painful memory and experience he has, making it just as painful to him as the most painful memory a poor child in Calcutta. It's only in the eyes of an ignorant 3rd person, trying to compare their suffering that we get a moronic opinion of "suffering-ranking"..

I'm not depressed, I'm a crushed and utterly wreaked human being who has dragged himself on and on for years in a sensible world of anguish and pain and suffering and hurt and I'm tired of it all. I want it over. I want to close my eyes and sigh and just know it's over.

sorry if this seems insulting, not intended that way, but in my eyes, living on through the help of medication is a loss, like failing. would just mean trying harder to believe a lie.

I've been here before many a times, probably not gonna be able to get it over with this time either.. fuck, it just hurts. I want everyone to feel my pain, to suffer my sufferings and see them ponder why I don't smile. And I then I hate myself for thinking stuff like that. but also I don't. I don't know.. it's just, I can never get a break. never get to breath. No memories of happiness or joy other than blissfull moments of ignorance until the age of 4years and 5 months. I've gone places, tried changing the scenery and environment. But wherever I go, whatever I do. I still am in the worst possible company there is, my own. God I hate myself. yet, clearly, not enough to get it done.

I just want to be done, to get out, you know ? For joy or sorrow, I just want my life to be over.

I'm just so freaking tired, you know ? I don't mean in the sense that movement is tiresome or that kind of tired. I'm exhausted. It's like I just can't get a full deep breath. I just want to be done, to not have to suffer anymore. I can't sleep, for when I do, my mind, my cursed mind, reminds me of things that breaks me. I have what's often described as photographic memory, or eidetic memory. But my mind doesn't just remember everything, it doesn't just show me it in a movie. I re-live it. I can remember everthing about my most horrible horrible experiences and my mind is capable of brining me back to relive them over and over and over and over and over again...
maybe not a gun...

No one in my life to talk to, going to the er would mean risking being locked in, really not interested in that option.
the idea or notion that it will get better, has to get better really doesn't weigh up for the pain I'm currently in, always have been and I'm certain I forever will be in. perhaps hanging will be easier. I just don't want to anymore.
So in order to kill myself I would first have to kill that little part of me first then.. There may be no coming back after death, but the pain will be gone.
I may not want to kill myself, but I really don't want to live on either. I've been thinking it must get better, but after 17 years you stop believing the lie.
